name: Weights & Biases
tagline: Weights & Biases (W&B) is the leading machine learning operations platform, used by AI researchers and engineers to track experiments, visualise training runs, manage datasets, and deploy models. Every hyperparameter, metric, and artifact from a training run is automatically logged and versioned, making it trivial to reproduce any past result or compare hundreds of experiments side by side. From OpenAI to individual researchers, W&B is the default experiment tracking tool for serious ML work.
